subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Kumusta RECIPIENT_NAME,
Sundot lang sa naunang sulat ko tungkol sa completed application sa inyong marketplace. May bagong konteksto: ayon sa 2025 Hiring, Compensation and Benefits Report ng JobStreet by SEEK, ang Pilipinas na ngayon ang pinaka-aktibong job market sa Southeast Asia sa 83% activity level, kaya tumitindi ang kumpetisyon sa kandidato. Kasabay nito, ang mga ahensya rito ay naniningil ng 15% hanggang 25% ng unang taong sahod kapag napuno ang puwesto, kaya mabigat ang bawat malinis na completed application. Doon nakatulong ang incrementality at holdout testing namin. Ikukumpara kaya natin sa kasalukuyan ninyong source mix?
angle: fresh angle: PH most active SEA job market 83% (JobStreet by SEEK, sourced) + PH agency take-rate 15-25% benchmark
register_notes: Stage 2 tl jobs_recruitment CPS: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior; fresh angle = timely sourced development (Philippines most active SEA job market at 83% activity, JobStreet by SEEK 2025 report) plus real benchmark band (PH agency take-rate 15-25% of first-year salary), both web-verified with URLs in enrichment_sources; JobStreet named from brand_candidates (rotated in for stage 2); no MobUpps figure this stage; incrementality/holdout referenced without a number; native Tagalog register; exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
